_readme: The registry of CLAIMS this repository has WITHDRAWN, and the spellings that must not reappear. WFG-062. One entry per withdrawn claim: what was withdrawn, the artifact or escalation that withdrew it, the pragma tokens that license a deliberate mention, and the banned spellings. scripts/check_withdrawn_claims.py checks EVERY tracked .md and .html against every entry; tests/test_withdrawn_claims_registry.py is the gate. Adding a claim here gates it across the whole tree at once: that is the point of the file. See docs/withdrawn_claims.md for what it does and does NOT do.

scope._readme: The default is EVERY tracked .md and .html file. `record_prefixes` is the one exception class and every member carries a reason: these are the files whose job is to QUOTE a withdrawn claim in order to record that it was withdrawn. No judge reads them. A path may not be both a record path and a member of a hand-rolled guard list in tests/test_detection_ordering_is_not_claimed.py; the gate refuses that.

record_prefixes.why: every lap's report; their subject is often the claim that was withdrawn that lap
retired documents, kept under CHARTER §3 rule 7 (never delete) precisely as a record
the lessons file; a lesson about a withdrawn claim has to name it
escalations quote the claim they are asking the author about (NH-019 is one)
rows quote the withdrawn sentence as the row's own definition of done
the critic's series table quotes findings verbatim
the current critic findings, which name the claims they found
the readiness lines carry the finding history against each tick
the direction page quotes the critic's notes verbatim
the standing brief cites the claims as worked examples of its own rules
the verbatim routine prompts, a record by construction (CHARTER §9)
generated by scripts/auto/report.py from BACKLOG.md, which is itself a record path

The 80-character window is measured rather than guessed: 「already」 and 「PDFs」 are 22 characters apart in the manifest and 「이미」 and 「PDF」 are 7 apart in Q39, and a window this wide also catches the reordering 「PDF 로 이미 커밋」 --- no, it does not, which is stated here rather than implied: this pattern is a copy-paste ratchet over the two spellings the repository actually used, and docs/withdrawn_claims.md §4 carries the general limit that a reworded assertion escapes

the unregistered count, which is the half that survived WFG-151's correction and sat in R7's own definition cell for another two windows. claims.title: the two Korean operational systems do not publish a reproduction method
claims.claim: 앞의 두 시스템(국립산림과학원 산불확산예측시스템, 경기도 G-DAPS)은 재현 방법을 공개하지 않습니다 --- an assertion about the contents of documents this repository has never opened, printed on the booth panel as the closing clause of the WildfireGuardian row
claims.withdrawn_by: dev lap 2026-09-07T1528Z (WFG-162), on critic #35's one fix-before-next-row item, and then narrowed a SECOND time by that lap's own independent reviewer, which is the part worth recording. The lap's first repair wrote 「공개된 자료에서는 ... 확인되지 않습니다」 --- still a claim about ALL published material, from a panel whose own closing section says it read only a catalogue record and press. The shipped wording is 「이 패널이 읽은 자료(카탈로그 기록·언론 보도)에서는」, which is what the sources support. The NIFoS user guide (연구자료 제1201호, about 18 MB PDF) is NH-039, open and unfetched; the 경향신문 G-DAPS article says nothing about reproduction. The source survey docs/related_work.md:134 wrote the same cell as 「not stated」 twice and was right the whole time --- the panel that summarises it went one step further than the document it summarises, which its own header at :3-5 forbids in those words (「원본을 요약할 뿐 새로운 숫자를 만들지 않습니다」; it made a new CLAIM, and no gate reads claims). ⚠ The lap ALSO tried to close this with a hand grep instead of a registration --- four family patterns over docs/ paper/ release/ web/ scripts/, which did return the one live instance --- and its reviewer blocked on exactly that: CHARTER §3.5c exists because the hand grep is the thing that keeps failing, so a grep that happens to be right is the pattern, not the defence. Fourth instance of the unregistered-withdrawal shape in four days (WC-004 §5a, WC-005 §5d, WC-006 §5e).
claims.artifact: docs/auto/finals/RELATED_WORK_PANEL.md, the WildfireGuardian row and the dated ⚠ correction beneath it, rebuilt into the booth kit in the same lap (WFG-152) so the printed page and the tree agree; docs/related_work.md:134, which carries the honest register 「not stated」 for both systems and did not change
claims.say_instead: 이 패널이 읽은 자료(카탈로그 기록·언론 보도)에서는 앞의 두 시스템의 재현 절차가 확인되지 않습니다. --- and if a judge presses: 국립산림과학원 사용자가이드 원문은 아직 열어 보지 못했습니다, so we do not know what it does or does not contain.

spellings.why: the shipped spelling, anchored on the subject (재현 방법/절차) and the predicate (공개하지 않). The window is measured rather than guessed: in the line this repository actually printed, 「방법」 and 「공개하지」 are 2 characters apart. ⚠ The limit is the one docs/withdrawn_claims.md §4 states for every pattern here and it bites unusually hard on this claim: the assertion can be reworded into 「밝히지 않습니다」, 「비공개입니다」 or 「does not publish」 and escape, and the lap that registered this checked those four rewordings by hand rather than by gate. What this pattern IS is a copy-paste ratchet: it stops the exact sentence being pasted back into any of the 931 gated files, which is how WC-004 and WC-006 both survived. The dated correction note in RELATED_WORK_PANEL.md deliberately does NOT quote the withdrawn sentence and therefore needs no forbidden-ok pragma --- WC-005's precedent, chosen for the same reason: it is a page the student hands a judge, and reprinting a withdrawn sentence verbatim on paper to record that it was withdrawn puts it back in front of the judge.

claims.title: the two Korean operational systems do not compute a household-level walk-out route
claims.claim: stated as a flat negative about what NIFoS's console and 경기도's G-DAPS DO NOT compute --- 「which household can still walk out, and along which path」 (docs/related_work.md row 13, in a column headed 「what it does not compute」), 「anything below the township; a walking route for one person」 (row 14), and 「It does not answer 「can the person in this house walk out, and along which path」」 (docs/auto/knowledge/KOREAN_OPERATIONAL_SYSTEMS.md §2)
claims.withdrawn_by: the paper routine's lap 2026-09-07T1529Z retracted the manuscript's own spelling of it (§2, 「neither answers which household can still walk out and by which path」) at 8ff1b40 on its independent reviewer's block, and that reviewer found the same assertion still live on docs/related_work.md rows 13-14 --- the page §2 is built from --- and filed NH-044, because CHARTER §12 does not let the paper routine edit outside paper/. Dev lap 2026-09-07T1528Z, which held the same claim family open for WFG-162, narrowed those two rows and registered them here in the same lap. ⚠ A THIRD live instance surfaced during registration that neither routine had named: docs/auto/knowledge/KOREAN_OPERATIONAL_SYSTEMS.md §2, the note CHARTER §13 says a lap or the student looks a concept up in --- WFG-163's shape exactly, and the second time this week that a knowledge note was the file a correction did not reach. All three now read the same register as the survey's own reproducibility row: NOT STATED IN WHAT WAS OPENED. The NIFoS user guide is NH-039, catalogued and unfetched; row 14 and the knowledge note rest on one 경향신문 article.
claims.artifact: docs/related_work.md rows 13-14 and the dated correction above the provenance block; docs/auto/knowledge/KOREAN_OPERATIONAL_SYSTEMS.md §2; paper/manuscript.md §2 at 8ff1b40, whose references.bib note for nifos2026guide has read 「Only the catalogue page was opened」 since paper lap 13 --- the apparatus was right one citation click away from the prose the whole time
claims.say_instead: not stated in what was opened --- a catalogue entry and press reports describe no output of that kind, and the primary documentation has not been read (NH-039). Never 「it does not do X」 about a system whose manual nobody here has opened.

spellings.why: the exact spelling BOTH surviving live instances used --- docs/related_work.md row 13's cell and the knowledge note's 「can the person in this house walk out, and along which path」 --- anchored on the comma that separates it from the project's own POSITIVE uses of the same idea. That distinction is the whole design of this pattern: 「which household to reach first and along which walking route」 and 「which household can still walk out and by which path」 (no comma, 「by」) are what this project says about ITSELF and about its own output object, they appear across the manuscript, the survey and this knowledge note, and a pattern that caught them would be a gate against the project's own frame. ⚠ Two limits, stated rather than implied. (1) The retracted MANUSCRIPT spelling 「neither answers which household can still walk out and by which path」 is deliberately NOT registered here: it is already gone from paper/manuscript.md, and every remaining copy is a ledger line in paper/GAPS.md and paper/README.md recording the retraction, which a dev lap should not be pragma-annotating across another routine's files. (2) Row 14's spelling 「anything below the township; a walking route for one person」 has no shared phrase with row 13 and is not reachable by this pattern --- it was corrected by hand in the same commit and nothing ratchets it. docs/withdrawn_claims.md §4 carries the general form of both limits.

THE KOREAN HALF, registered by dev lap 20260907T1820Z on WFG-166 --- ninety minutes after the English half went in, and the whole reason CHARTER §3.5c now says a lap registers both languages or writes down which one it did not. The English pattern is anchored on a comma in a Latin-script phrase and structurally cannot reach a Korean sentence, so the claim went on being said aloud in Korean on the card the student recites (docs/auto/JUDGE_QA.md:650-652) while the registry read green. ⚠ The subject grep this lap was ordered to run found a SECOND live copy that neither critic #36 nor the backlog row named: docs/auto/finals/RELATED_WORK_PANEL.md:67-69, the printed panel whose OTHER clause the 20260907T1528Z lap had corrected for WC-007 in the same file one lap earlier. One lap, one page, two clauses of the same shape, one of them fixed. Both copies print: `pages_per_source` in `docs/auto/finals/printables/manifest_20260907T1825Z.json` gives `docs/auto/JUDGE_QA.md` 19 pages and `docs/auto/finals/RELATED_WORK_PANEL.md` 3, of the kit's 38. ⚠ The first draft of this entry wrote 「20 of 38」, a number no artifact supports and which this lap's independent reviewer blocked; the manifest is the artifact and it says 19 + 3. ⚠ Two limits, stated rather than implied. (1) The pattern matches the OBJECT of the negation (「특정한 집의 어느 길이 … 들어가지 않는지는」), not the predicate, because the sentence wrapped across a line break in BOTH files it lived in and this checker is line-based --- a copy that re-wraps so the object splits escapes it. (2) It is anchored on 「특정한 집의」, which the project's own POSITIVE sentences about its output object do not use: they say 「가구 단위의 대피 경로」 and 「어느 집을 먼저, 어느 길로」. A rewording into either of those escapes by construction, as docs/withdrawn_claims.md §4 says of every pattern here.
